paragraphs: R. Chananyah ben Akashya, in the Mishnah at the end of Makkot and end of Avot: “The Holy One, blessed be He, wished to confer merit upon Israel.” He is mentioned in three places in the Tosefta concerning R. Akiva's words, with R. Chanina ben Gamliel and R. Shimon. His burial is at Kefar Anan; see Chalafta of Kefar Chananyah: Gelilot Eretz Yisrael.
